historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; returns formatted address text but omits raw byte, Type 38 length, BMC identity and 7-bit/8-bit convention.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds representation-aware read-only validation and forbids active scans, but lowers capability for inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; retained direct agent collection after operator target selection and command sanity review.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Validate the Type 38 I2C Target Address byte for the identified BMC/IPMI device under the documented platform 7-bit or 8-bit representation, using read-only evidence and confirming persistence after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 38 with length/handle, preserve the target byte, interpret it only under the approved address convention and BMC identity, compare with platform design or read-only controller inventory, and repeat after approved reboot without bus probing.
manual_activity: A user supplies the BMC identity, expected target/convention and reboot plan; no physical access or active bus operation is required.
required_inputs: Expected BMC I2C target and authoritative design source
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and documented inventory only; never scan, probe, write or reset the I2C bus.
Preserve the raw address byte and do not silently shift between 7-bit and 8-bit formats.
Correlate the Type 38 record to the correct BMC before comparison.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on ambiguous identity/convention or management loss and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate record length/identity, extract the raw target byte, apply the approved convention, compare read-only design/inventory evidence and diff pre/post reboot.
Report ambiguity, mismatch or record drift without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the BMC identity, expected address/convention and comparison source plus reboot plan.
Resolve representation or design discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant despite the source typo, but grep cannot prove raw byte, record length/BMC identity or address convention.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 38; report handle/length, raw target byte, approved 7-/8-bit interpretation, BMC identity, read-only baseline and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source spelling, Type 38 target, linked script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no bus scan is substituted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Length-validate and identify Type 38, preserve the raw target byte, interpret it using an approved 7-/8-bit convention, compare with documented/read-only BMC evidence and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing Type 38 IPMI Device Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and design-source versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 38 I2C Target Address definition and platform BMC bus design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw representation, BMC identity and safe comparison without active scanning.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects one-bit shifts, wrong-device correlation and truncated records hidden by formatted output.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected target, address convention and BMC identity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A documented address is not proof that a live bus transaction succeeds; active I2C probing is outside this safe metadata case.

project_override_considerations: Projects may document either 7-bit or 8-bit presentation, but must preserve the raw byte and explicit conversion; an active scan or Linux bus address cannot silently replace the BMC/platform-management baseline.
expected_evidence: Approved BMC identity, expected target, address convention and baseline source
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 38 with handle/length and target byte
Representation-aware decoded address and read-only design/inventory comparison
Statement that no I2C scan/probe/write occurred
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot byte diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Items spelling omits the final 's' but the Type 38 target-address intent and matching command are unambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw extraction, representation conversion and baseline comparison are fully automatable after inputs; no active bus access is necessary.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw address representation, BMC identity and safe no-probe boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its I2C safety controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats missing address design/reboot inputs as readiness and keeps engineer verdict separate.

review_improvement: Prevents a formatted address from passing after an implicit bit shift or wrong-BMC comparison, while avoiding unsafe bus discovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a firmware metadata byte and can be validated entirely through read-only parsing/comparison; active I2C behavior is a different test.
